metadata.title: saberu | We build and run web software
metadata.description: saberu is an independent software studio. We design, build, and maintain focused web software, on your own servers if you prefer.

hero.title: We build focused web software and keep it running
hero.lead: Tell us the problem. We design the simplest software that solves it, build it, and maintain it after launch, on your own servers if you prefer.

services.heading: What we do
services.intro: We do three kinds of work, each starting from your problem rather than from a technology. You can ask for one of them or all three.

build.title: A tool for a specific job
build.body: When ready-made software does not fit how you work, we design and build a web application that does, without features you will not use.

run.title: Maintenance after launch
run.body: Software needs ongoing care. We apply updates and security fixes, monitor it, test that backups can be restored, and fix problems as they arise.

host.title: Hosting on your own servers
host.body: If you would rather keep data and services on your own servers than on a third-party platform, we set up that infrastructure and look after it.

approach.heading: How we work
approach.intro: We follow three rules on every project, so you know what to expect.

scope.title: Scope agreed in advance
scope.body: Before we build, we agree in writing on what the software will and will not do. Then we work in small steps you can review one at a time.

verify.title: Checked before release
verify.body: We test every change before it goes live, and we can return to the previous version if something goes wrong. You can see what changed and why.

ownership.title: Code and data stay yours
ownership.body: You keep the code, the data, and access to every account. We document the setup, so you can continue with us or without us.

about.heading: About saberu
about.body: saberu is an independent software studio. We do not stop at delivery: after launch, we stay responsible for keeping the software updated and running. To learn more about how we work, or whether we can take on your project, write to us.

contact.heading: Write to us
contact.body: A few lines are enough to start: what you want to solve and any constraints, such as timing, budget, or where it has to run.
